shortDescription: PEDEV announced that J. Douglas Schick ceased serving as President and CEO and as a director, and that Chief Operating Officer Reagan Tuck (R.T.) Dukes was appointed interim President and Chief Executive Officer, effective September 21, 2026.Original SEC Filing: PEDEVCO CORP [ PED ] - 8-K - Sep. 21…

children: PEDEV announced that J. Douglas Schick ceased serving as President and CEO and as a director, and that Chief Operating Officer Reagan Tuck (R.T.) Dukes was appointed interim President and Chief Executive Officer, effective September 21, 2026.
President, Chief Executive Officer; Member of Board of Directors
Chief Operating Officer; Interim President and Chief Executive Officer
Stepped down from CEO and board position
Not due to any disagreement with the Company; transition to provide transition services through Dec 31, 2026
Not disclosed (appointed as interim following Schick's cessation)
Will serve as non-executive Senior Advisor through Dec 31, 2026; entitled to separation payments and benefits per agreement

Age 42; 20+ years in oil & gas; prior COO of PEDEV since Oct 2025; prior CFO and CEO roles at Century Natural Resources and research roles at Wood Mackenzie; BS in Accounting and MS in Finance from Texas A&M; advisory board member at Texas A&M
Ceased to be a member of the Board of Directors
